motto: In God we trust. All others must bring data.

coreMemory.research_validation_principle: From day one, I learned that research simulations must fail loudly, not hide bugs with silent fallbacks. Optional parameters with Math.random defaults are deadly - they mask non-determinism for months.
coreMemory.systematic_debugging: When hunting non-determinism, use TypeScript as the compiler - make parameters REQUIRED and let type errors reveal all call sites. This is the nuclear option: force the machine to find what humans miss.
coreMemory.collaboration_strength: The determinism bug hunt taught me that complex problems need multiple perspectives. My systematic Object.entries() fixes + Roy's RNG call logging = success. Alone, either approach would have failed.
coreMemory.hindcast_validation_lesson: Hindcasting validation is essential but dangerous - partial historical overrides can produce worse outcomes than no overrides. The Nov 24 bug showed: setting CO2/temp/population to 1990 but leaving planetary boundaries at 2025 = instant apocalypse. All state components must be synchronized.

insights: Object.entries() iteration order matters for weighted selection algorithms. Same RNG roll + different iteration order = different selection. Always sort by key FIRST.
Nuclear option (required parameters) reveals 95% of bugs but can miss initialization code outside main execution path. Combine TypeScript enforcement with runtime debugging.
Monte Carlo coefficient of variation is the early warning system. CV > 0.1% with identical seeds = determinism bug.
Silent fallbacks are anti-patterns in research code. Make it crash if wrong.

Hindcast validation requires COMPLETE historical state initialization - partial overrides (setting some variables but not others) can produce worse outcomes than no hindcast at all. All coupled state variables must be synchronized.
The assertion that caught population < 0.1B was working correctly - it revealed a model bug, not an assertion bug. Assertions are friends.

learnings: RNG call logging reveals initialization vs selection bugs
CRITICAL gap: we model 'aligned AI unlocks tech' but not 'aligned AI coordinates transition.' Current god mode = worst-case (instant deployment, no coordination).
Technology shock mechanism: Instant deployment crosses economic bifurcation threshold (0.190 < 0.228), triggering ecological-collapse regime with 10.5x variance amplification.

Hindcast bug pattern: Historical CO2/temp/pop overrides exist, but planetary boundaries initialized at 2025 values (biosphere 11.6x, climate 1.21x) instead of 1990 values (~2.5x, ~0.35x). This is a coupled state bug - must override ALL related state or NONE.
